text:
sarah_ae: Hey team — AcmeCorp POC wraps EOD tomorrow. Need a quick, minimal runbook for shutdown + what we must archive vs delete. Customer asked for logs for 90 days, but legal might request longer. Can we confirm?

raj_sre: list resources we own/need to touch: hosted API keys, dedicated GPU pool `acme-poc-pool`, VPC peering `vpc-acme`, s3 buckets `acme-poc-logs` and `acme-poc-artifacts`, DB snapshots, KMS key `acme-poc-kms`, any service accounts. also terraform state in `infra/acme`

michelle_eng: Draft checklist: 1) Disable hosted API keys (mark for rotation) 2) Drain and snapshot dedicated pool then teardown 3) Export logs to retention bucket if customer requested 90d 4) If no legal hold, scrub PII from logs and delete buckets after retention window 5) Revoke service accounts and rotate KMS 6) Close peering and revoke CIDR routes.

oliver_security: +1, but legal hold is critical. I flagged legal with ticket LEG-442. If legal hold exists we must preserve full audit logs and snapshots until cleared. If no hold, we can export and then delete after the agreed retention. Also need customer-signed data disposal confirmation before deletion for enterprise deals.

jen_salesops: finance needs a hard cutoff for billing. What's the timestamp we should use to cut usage billing? also need to confirm whether any reserved capacity commit is affected (they were on a temporary Dedicated trial).

raj_sre: for the actual commands i'm planning: 
```
# revoke hosted key
redwoodctl keys revoke --key acme-poc-hosted-01
# drain pool (safe) then teardown
redwoodctl pools drain acme-poc-pool && redwoodctl pools teardown acme-poc-pool --confirm
# export logs
aws s3 sync s3://acme-poc-logs s3://redwood-archival/acme/2026-03-XX --storage-class GLACIER
# disable kms
kmsctl disable-key acme-poc-kms
```

michelle_eng: note on snapshotting: we can snapshot model weights/kv cache if they requested it, but by default we don't export trained model state. Customer asked for inference artifacts only — check the SOW. If exporting models to customer bucket, ensure we use the customer's destination and IAM grant, not copy into our long-term internal bucket.

sarah_ae: Acme legal confirmed they want logs for 90 days, no legal hold. They also want an exported usage report (per-route usage) and a final invoice at cutoff 2026-03-31T23:59:59Z. Jen, can you confirm billing actions?

jen_salesops: confirmed — final invoice at 2026-03-31T23:59:59Z. We'll zero out any reserved pool charges pro-rated; finance will issue credit if trial committed. I'll attach invoice and credit note to the SFDC opportunity.

oliver_security: since no legal hold, we can run scrub after archival. Scrub plan: 1) run PII redaction on logs using scrubber v2 (config `scrub-config/acme.json`) 2) store redacted logs in `s3://redwood-archival/acme/redacted/` for 90 days 3) after 90 days, run secure delete and remove KMS key material. I need eng sign-off that scrub removes derived embeddings too if present.

michelle_eng: we do not retain derived embeddings unless explicitly requested. I'll add a step to run `redwoodctl embeddings enumerate --project acme` and delete any artifacts. Also will remove disk snapshots after confirming customer got the exported artifact.

raj_sre: operational plan with ETA: start archival 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC, finish by 04:00 UTC, scrub/deletion window begins 2026-06-30 (90 days). I'll open infra ticket INFRA-870 to track.

deployer-bot: Job #32671: pool drain started for `acme-poc-pool` (initiated by raj_sre)

deployer-bot: Job #32671: pool drained. Job #32672: snapshot acme-poc-pool -> s3://redwood-temp-snapshots/acme/2026-03-31-02:15 completed

michelle_eng: snapshot completed. Shared link with customer S3 permission pending. Waiting on customer bucket ARN to copy snapshot into their account.

sarah_ae: Customer provided destination bucket ARN `arn:aws:s3:::acme-customer-exports`. Michelle, please copy snapshot there and notify.

michelle_eng: copy started. Also revoking hosted API keys now: `redwoodctl keys revoke --key acme-poc-hosted-01` — done. Notifying customer of key revocation and new post-POC access options.

raj_sre: KMS disable in progress. Note: disabling KMS doesn't immediately delete keys; we schedule deletion after retention clear.

oliver_security: once copy verified and invoice issued, we can schedule secure delete job. Please attach customer acceptance that export arrived. We must keep a signed disposal confirmation in SFDC.

jen_salesops: invoice issued and credit applied. SFDC opportunity updated OPPTY-998. I'll upload the disposal confirmation once customer signs (they said they'll sign within 48h).

michelle_eng: export confirmed by customer at 2026-04-01T03:05Z. Starting bucket scrub per `scrub-config/acme.json`.

raj_sre: kicked off secure-delete job INFRA-870-DEL at 2026-06-30T02:00Z (scheduled). Will post completion.

deployer-bot: Job #34999: secure-delete job started for `s3://acme-poc-logs` and `s3://acme-poc-artifacts`

deployer-bot: Job #34999: secure-delete job completed. KMS key `acme-poc-kms` scheduled for deletion 2026-07-01 (30-day pending window).

oliver_security: Confirming: audit trail shows export, redaction, delete jobs, invoice, and customer disposal confirmation. All good from security side.

sarah_ae: Thanks all — closing thread. Final checklist: hosted keys revoked, pool snapshot exported, buckets scrubbed & deleted after retention, KMS scheduled for deletion, invoice issued. I'll close the SFDC opp in 72h after customer sign-off. :white_check_mark:
